author: Mehrp
body:
Just finished making another map titled "Irisudo" This map is mainly about gameplay (hopefully), hence the less detail.

Stuffs:
-=-Spawns are underneath iron to ensure a decent-sized period of 'spawning' 
-=-4 Diamond blocks that are spread out (so its hard to get a full dia set)
-=-Lots of iron
-=-Two monuments

Bonus stuffs:
-=-Map looks like an eye!
-=-Teams are "Aye" vs "Eye"
